scope: Retained OpenCode v1.18.21 r4 Actionlint and normalized Zizmor workflow/action findings; source-level risk triage only. This artifact does not modify the canonical security review, approval records, or activation gate.

aggregate.interpretation: All reviewed locations are upstream GitHub workflow/action source, not OpenCode application runtime code. Several workflows nevertheless have real CI privilege/input risks if an operator relies on or runs those upstream workflows. This review neither grants human acceptance nor changes the OpenCode activation gate.
